releases.notes: Fixes and documentation only — the 13 tools and their names are unchanged. `doctor --fix` corrects a stale pipx-record version IN PLACE (sessions and MCP servers can stay running) and no longer counts its own launcher as a venv holder, so a genuinely idle venv no longer reads as held; a timed-out `run_with_credential` no longer kills the server on POSIX; `compat --from-git` / `--sync-skill` DISCOVER the checkout and the skill clone instead of using a hardcoded path (override with PSAMVAULT_MCP_REPO / PSAMVAULT_SKILL_CLONE); `scan_and_protect` now forwards `project_name`, so the documented per-project namespace exists. Docs: the repo gained a docs/ tree a website can populate from, and the README/SKILL.md no longer describe an HTTP transport that was never implemented.

BREAKING (CLI surface, not tools): the `psamvault-compat` console script is removed — use `psamvault-mcp compat`; new `selfcheck` and `doctor` subcommands. `compat --check` now asks PyPI and reports update_available; `--apply --latest` installs the newest published release (requires --allow-breaking when it is newer than the installed contract); upgrades prefer pipx when the venv is free so entry points stay linked. The 13 MCP tools are unchanged — set breaking=false if you only care about the tool surface.

Verify recipes for Tavily and GitHub; --sync-skill (skill-only updates); the recorded skill version is a floor (skill_ahead is healthy); upgrade safety for --apply (snapshot, --pull stash/pull/restore, smoke test, rollback) and a no-downgrade guard shared by --apply and --sync-skill.
Fix: psamvault-compat --apply refreshes the index cache, so a just-published release installs immediately instead of failing on cached metadata.
export_key_to_env_file added (.env targets); capture_stripe_credentials removed. Tool count stays 13, so only the fingerprint catches this.
Auto-verifying export gate for HTTP keys.
